Zoe Kim: SaffronCloud pinged us about an unexpected negative balance on invoice INV-2026-782. They say a promo refund was applied twice. Can someone investigate?
BillingBot: Invoice INV-2026-782 created at 2026-04-07T08:12:03Z. Detected duplicate promo line: promo_saffron_trial applied twice. Negative total: -$1,450.
Marcus Li: Account acct_sc_77. I see two promo lines with identical promo_id and same correlation token. Likely webhook retry.
Zoe Kim: Customer prefers a cash refund if possible. They need zero balance for month-end.
Marcus Li: Policy check: cash refunds between $1k-$2k require Finance Manager approval. I'll prepare RFC and GL impact (reverse to 4-701) and queue payment.
Teresa Lambert: Reviewing RFC. Approve one-time cash refund $1,450 to SaffronCloud. Please document refund ref REF-2026-410 and update AR ticket ZD-10112.
Sam Ortiz: Payment PR-487 executed via ACH to bank ending 7789 at 2026-04-07T11:05:32Z. Customer confirmed receipt.
Zoe Kim: Noted. Marcus, can you add an idempotency guard to the promo service and a pre-finalization negative-balance check?
Marcus Li: Will add dedupe on correlation_id and a preflight invoice validator to block negative totals. Filing follow-up in ENG-OPS ticket.
BillingBot: REF-2026-410 posted and PR-487 closed at 2026-04-07T11:06:10Z. ZD-10112 updated.
Zoe Kim: Thanks team — closing thread :white_check_mark:
